name: Redemption for Jessika
source: Working as a court scribe, you are called upon to transcribe the trial proceedings of your favourite rock star Jessika. Who stands accused of enticing a riot at one of her shows. Due to your connections you get to meet Jessika and learn more about her and special power, but not all is as it seems.
